projects.name: Simultaneous Functional Ultrasound, Intrinsic Optical Signal, and Widefield Calcium Neuroimaging
projects.summary: Trimodal imaging platform combining fUS, intrinsic optical signal (IOS), and widefield calcium imaging to simultaneously capture cerebral hemodynamics and neural activity in the awake and anaesthetized rodent brain.
highlights: Established awake-mouse fUS imaging as a lab capability; built acquisition on Verasonics Vantage and Vantage NXT with Arduino TTL synchronization
Cross-validated fUS against intrinsic hemoglobin signals and derived transfer functions to characterize sensitivity and linearity
Demonstrated multiscale imaging in a glioblastoma (GBM) mouse model

projects.name: Transparent Ultrasound Transducer Cranial Window for Ultrasound Neuromodulation and Imaging
projects.summary: Transparent ultrasound transducer (TUT) cranial window over thinned skull for simultaneous ultrasound neuromodulation and multimodal optical and photoacoustic imaging in awake mice.
highlights: Developed surgical preparation and cranial window protocol for chronic awake-mouse imaging
Built optical imaging setups for intrinsic optical signal and widefield calcium imaging
Assessed hemodynamic parameters and demonstrated neurovascular-coupling-driven responses to ultrasound stimulation

projects.name: Multi-Parametric Ultrafast Ultrasound and Photoacoustic Imaging Platform for Mice Brain Imaging
projects.summary: Combined ultrafast ultrasound and photoacoustic system to assess cerebral hemodynamic and oxygen saturation changes in rodent brains.
highlights: Contributed ultrasound localization imaging methods, code development, and data analysis
Worked on ULM data analysis applied to a glioblastoma (GBM) mouse model

projects.name: Development of Transparent Ultrasound Transducers
projects.summary: Development and characterization of PMN-PT and lithium niobate-based transparent ultrasound transducers for multimodal optical and photoacoustic imaging.
highlights: Characterized performance and noise via pulse-echo, hydrophone pressure, and photoacoustic measurements (PiezoCAD modeling, MATLAB analysis)
Showed PMN-PT is a viable alternative to lithium niobate; designed an electrical impedance matching circuit to improve performance

projects.name: Fiber-Optic Interferometer Hydrophone Sensor Array
projects.summary: Design of sensor arrays, homodyne PGC interrogation, passive path imbalance measurement, and TDM multiplexing.
highlights: Homodyne phase-generated carrier implementation and acoustic signal recovery
Five-sensor interferometer array with time-division multiplexing

projects.name: Chaos in Erbium-Doped Fiber Ring Lasers

projects.name: Digital Communication Using Chaotic Signals
